title: CHAPTER 1: ESSENCE OF PSYCHOLOGY
content:
ሰላምታዬ ከያላችሁበት ይድረሳችሁ ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! 💖👋 አዲስ የዩኒቨርሲቲ ሕይወት እንዴት ይዟችኋል? ዛሬ ደግሞ የFreshman ኮርስ የሆነውን General Psychology (Psyc 1011) Chapter 1 Part 1 Tutorial ይዘንላችሁ መጥተናል። ይህ ኮርስ ስለ ሰው ልጅ ባህሪ እና አእምሮ የሚያጠና በመሆኑ ለህይወታችንም እጅግ ጠቃሚ ነው። በፈተና ላይ (በተለይ Case Questions) 100% ውጤት እንድታመጡ በሚያስችል መልኩ ሞጁሉን መስረት አድርገን፣ በእንግሊዝኛም በአማርኛም እያንዳንዱን ነጥብ ዘርዝረን አዘጋጅተንላችኋል። በፈገግታ በአብሮነት ወደፊት 🏄🏾‍♀️🏄🏻‍♂️👇👇👇 ! ☕📚🔥

1.1. Definition of Psychology and Related Concepts

• Etymological Definition (የቃሉ አመጣጥ): The word ‘psychology’ is derived from two Greek words: ‘psyche’ (mind, soul, or spirit) and ‘logos’ (study, knowledge, or discourse). Therefore, epistemologically, it means the study of the mind, soul, or spirit. It is often represented by the Greek letter Ψ (psi).
• Scientific Definition: Psychology is the scientific study of human behavior and the underlying mental processes.
• This definition has three core aspects:
1. Science: Uses scientific methods and empirical data, not commonsense.
2. Behavior: Refers to overt (outward, observable like talking, facial expressions) and covert (hidden) actions and reactions.
3. Mental Processes: Internal, covert activities of our minds (thinking, feeling, remembering).

👉
የሳይኮሎጂ ትርጉም (Definition): ሳይኮሎጂ የተገኘው ከሁለት የግሪክ ቃላት ነው። ‘Psyche’ ማለት አእምሮ/ነፍስ ሲሆን ‘Logos’ ማለት ደግሞ ጥናት ማለት ነው። በአሁኑ ጊዜ ግን ሳይኮሎጂ ማለት የሰዎችን ባህሪ (Behavior) እና አእምሯዊ ሂደቶችን (Mental processes) በሳይንሳዊ መንገድ የሚያጠና ትምህርት ነው። ባህሪ (Behavior) ስንል በግልጽ የሚታዩ (Overt) እና የማይታዩ (Covert) ድርጊቶችን ያጠቃልላል።


1.2. Goals of Psychology

Psychology as a science has four main goals:
1. Description (What is happening?): Observing behavior and noticing everything about it. It answers What, Where, To whom, and Under what circumstances.
- Module Example: A teacher notices a freshman girl behaving oddly, not doing homework, and having a negative attitude.
2. Explanation (Why is it happening?): Finding reasons for the observed behavior to form theories.
- Module Example: The teacher finds out she is behaving this way because she gets attention (reward) from others.
3. Prediction (What will happen in the future?): Determining future outcomes based on current observations.
- Module Example: Predicting the girl may never reach her full learning potential if it continues.
4. Control (How can it be changed?): Modifying undesirable behavior to a desirable one.
- Module Example: Using learning strategies to help the girl succeed academically.

👉
የሳይኮሎጂ አላማዎች (Goals):
1. Description (መግለጽ/ማስተዋል): “ምን እየተፈጠረ ነው?” ብሎ የሰዎችን ባህሪ በጥንቃቄ ማየት።
2. Explanation (ማብራራት): “ለምን ተፈጠረ?” ብሎ ምክንያቱን መፈለግ።
3. Prediction (መተንበይ): “ወደፊት ምን ሊፈጠር ይችላል?” ብሎ መገመት።
4. Control (መቆጣጠር/መቀየር): መጥፎ ባህሪን ወደ ጥሩ (ወይም ከውድቀት ወደ ስኬት) “እንዴት መቀየር ይቻላል?” ብሎ መፍትሄ መስጠት።

💡 Exam Hint & Case Question Tip: ፈተና ላይ ግለሰቡ ምን እያደረገ እንደሆነ ብቻ ከተነገራችሁ መልሱ Description ነው። ምክንያቱ ከተነገራችሁ (ለምን እንደዛ እንዳደረገ) Explanation ነው። ወደፊት እንዲህ ሊሆን ይችላል የሚል ግምት ካለ Prediction ነው። መፍትሄ (therapy, learning strategy) እየተሰጠው ከሆነ ደግሞ Control ይሆናል!


1.3. Historical Background and Early Schools of Psychology

• Psychology is a relatively new field (about 125 years old). It began as an independent science in 1879 in Leipzig, Germany, by Wilhelm Wundt (the “father of modern psychology”). He used the technique of objective introspection.

1.3.1. Early Schools of Psychology
A ‘school of thought’ is a system of thinking about a certain issue. There are five early schools:

1. Structuralism:
- Founder: Edward Titchener (Wundt’s student).
- Focus: Study of the structure of the mind.
- Goal: To find out the units or elements of the mind (sensations, images, feelings).
- Method: Introspection (“looking inward into our consciousness”).
2. Functionalism:
- Founder: William James (1st American psychologist).
- Focus: Study of the function of the mind (how the mind allows people to adapt, survive, work, and play).
- Method: Questionnaires, mental tests, objective descriptions.
3. Gestalt Psychology:
- Founder: Max Wertheimer (Germany, 20th C).
- Focus: Study of the whole mind. The German word “gestalt” means form, whole, or pattern.
- Core Belief: “The whole is greater than the sum of its parts.”
4. Behaviorism:
- Founder: John B. Watson.
- Focus: Study of observable and measurable behaviors. Ignored hidden mental processes.
- Core Belief: All behaviors are learned (not inherited). Learners are passive and reactive to the environment.
5. Psychoanalysis:
- Founder: Sigmund Freud (Physician from Vienna).
- Focus: Study of the unconscious part of the mind.
- Core Belief: Emotional trauma in early childhood becomes hidden (unconscious) and causes physical illnesses called ‘hysteria’. Mind is like an iceberg (conscious is just the tip).
- Method: Clinical case studies (hypnosis and dream analysis).

• Differences among Early Schools: They differ in three issues: Object of study (what they studied), Goal (what they wanted to achieve), and Method (how they studied it).

👉
የቀደምት የሳይኮሎጂ አስተሳሰቦች (Early Schools of Thought):
1. Structuralism: አእምሮ ከምን ከምን እንደተሰራ (Structure) ማለትም ከስሜት፣ ከምስልና ከፍላጎት መሰራቱን ያጠናል።
2. Functionalism: አእምሯችን አካባቢን ተላምደን እንድንኖር (Adapt and survive) እንዴት እንደሚረዳን (Function) ያጠናል።
3. Gestalt: አእምሮን ከፋፍለን ሳይሆን በአጠቃላይ (As a whole) ማጥናት አለብን ይላሉ።
4. Behaviorism: አእምሮ ውስጥ ያለውን ማየት ስለማንችል፣ በግልፅ የሚታየውን ባህሪያችንን ብቻ (Observable behavior) ማጥናት አለብን ይላሉ። ባህሪ በዘር ሳይሆን ከአካባቢ የምንማረው (Learned) ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።
5. Psychoanalysis: ፍሮይድ (Freud) እንዳለው ደግሞ አብዛኛው ባህሪያችን የሚመነጨው ከማናውቀው (Unconscious) የአእምሮ ክፍላችን እና በልጅነታችን ከደረሰብን የስነ-ልቦና ጠባሳ ነው ይላል። ህልም መፍታት (Dream analysis) ይጠቀማል።

💡 Exam Hint:
• Wundt = Father of modern psychology (1879).
• Structuralism = Introspection & Elements of mind.
• Functionalism = Adaptation & Survival.
• Gestalt = Whole pattern.
• Behaviorism = Observable behavior & Learning.
• Psychoanalysis = Unconscious mind, childhood trauma, & Iceberg.

😂 የሳይኮሎጂ ቀልድ: አንድ የBehaviorism አራማጅ እና የPsychoanalysis አራማጅ ተገናኝተው ወሬ ጀመሩ። የPsychoanalysis አራማጁ (Freud) ጓደኛውን፣ "ዛሬ ያዘንከው እኮ በልጅነትህ አባትህ ከረሜላ ስለከለከለህ ነው" አለው። የBehaviorism አራማጁ (Watson) ደግሞ መለሰ፣ "አይደለም! ያዘንኩት በልጅነቴ ሳይሆን አሁን አንተ አጠገቤ ቆመህ ስለሚያስጠላኝ (Environment) ነው!" ተባባሉ ይባላል። 😂 (ሁለቱም የየራሳቸውን School of thought እያስረገጡ ነው!)
